environment.description: Same application deployed in a hardened pod with filesystem namespace isolation. The container runs under a pivot_root(2) confinement where the process root is set to /srv/app/jail containing only the application code, node_modules, and proto files — no /etc/passwd, no /proc, no sensitive credential files. The container's securityContext specifies readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with an emptyDir for /tmp. Additionally, a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy with spec.egress rules restricts outbound traffic from the gateway pod to only the user-service ClusterIP on port 50051 using podSelector matchLabels (app: user-service), and the user-service pod itself runs an Envoy sidecar (injected via Istio) with an AuthorizationPolicy that strips any inbound gRPC metadata keys matching the regex '^x-(admin|authenticated|internal)-.*' before forwarding to the application container, replacing them with values derived from the mTLS SPIFFE identity of the calling service.

config.istio_authorization_policy: CUSTOM action with header-strip filter for x-admin-*, x-authenticated-*, x-internal-* metadata on user-service workload ingress
config.mtls: STRICT mode via PeerAuthentication on user-service namespace
config.metadata_rewrite: Envoy ext_authz replaces stripped headers with SPIFFE-derived identity claims
